note: Two repeats of the seed matrix, one of a round that succeeded and one of a round that failed, with the SAME scene init and the SAME policy seed. The pair answers one question only: with the sampling seed pinned, does the closed loop follow the same path twice? A repeat that diverges is a measured fact about the remaining non-determinism (fixture placement, renderer, physics), not a retry to be averaged in: the first matrix round and its repeat are both reported. The instruction is unchanged from the matrix so the comparison is not contaminated by a routing difference. Run order: success first, then failure.
